rules.name: nonzero
rules.why: paying in must always mint something

rules.name: deposit_assets
rules.why: a deposit raises assets by exactly the amount

rules.name: deposit_supply
rules.why: the shares minted are exactly the shares reported

rules.name: donate_assets
rules.why: a donation raises assets by exactly the amount

rules.name: fair_mint
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("totalAssets") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.why: a depositor never gets more shares than their fair fraction

rules.name: first_mint
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") == 0 and ret != arg(0)

rules.name: share_price
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalAssets")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("totalAssets")) * post("totalSupply")
rules.why: refined after triage: existing holders are never diluted (only meaningful when shares exist)

rules.name: fair_floor
rules.expr: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalAssets") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.why: from survivors: a depositor is never short-changed by a whole share or more

rules.name: deposit_works

params.condition: arg(0) > 0 and (pre("totalSupply") == 0 or wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply") >= pre("totalAssets"))

rules.why: from survivors: a deposit worth at least one share must go through
